body.statement: For every \(\eta\in\mathfrak M_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai}}\), with \(\mathcal O=\mathcal O(\eta)\) formed from the faithful pooled selected laws \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\), the entirely observable closure satisfies \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{sel}}(\mathcal O)\subseteq A(\eta)\). The seed inclusion is Dai et al.'s intervention-created-adjacency certificate. At each recursive step, if \(i,j\in\mathsf C_{\mathrm{sel}}(\mathcal O)\) are the nonadjacent endpoints of an observational unshielded noncollider \(i-x-j\), then \(x\in A(\eta)\), so adjoining \(x\) preserves the inclusion.
body.justification: This theorem turns the noncollider closure into an observable sound certificate set that can legally appear in rule premises.
body.gap: Dai et al., Lemma 4 on p. 6, provides the cross-regime seed but does not state this noncollider closure; Wang, Du, and Zhou instead take singleton background knowledge as supplied.
body.consumer: It supplies the model-free selectedness predicate used by the local calculus while reserving \(A(\eta)\) for completeness witnesses.
